start.text: The tariff code describes the goods, not the tax you would prefer. Electronics, household goods, textiles or general goods.

choices.text: I will pay the duty: DDP.
I want the buyer to pay on arrival: DDU.

ddp.text: Include that duty in your margin. Buyers know the full price and refusals are less likely; it still does not guarantee a profit.

ddu.text: Your shipping bill is lower, but the buyer sees another charge at the border. Expect more refusals and return freight.
